facts.fact: The AssurCereals project, led by the Ecole Nationale d'Ingenieurs de Tunis with the national cartography and remote sensing centre, computed drought indices (SPI-3, SPEI-3, Kv) for cereal growers from weather observations and satellite data, with a closing workshop on 18-19 September 2024.

TUN.note: Nothing on AI rules or harms.
Only a conference talk on AI drought forecasting; no public system using AI stated.
No AI model, dataset or computing stated as built.
